title.name: Fluval
title.sub: Fluval LED lights in Home Assistant: every channel as a slider, real colour, effects, modes and a light that holds what you set. No cloud.

new.title: More Fluval lights
new.text: Reef 4.0, Plant 4.0, Plant Nano 4.0, Plant PRO, Siena 2.0 and A-Sky Aqua join the Reef Nano 4.0. The model comes from the Bluetooth advertisement.

new.title: Plant channels and colours
new.text: Plant models get Pink, Blue, Cold, Pure and Warm white, with colour mixing from their own LED spectra.

new.title: Calmer signal updates
new.text: Signal strength is written only on visible changes, odd confirmation replies are caught instead of raising errors.

new.title: Calendar versions
new.text: Year, month and the release of that month: 26.10.3 is the third release of October 2026.

features.title: Every channel a slider
features.text: All five LED channels from 0 to 100 %. A value above 0 switches on, all at 0 really switches off. Plus set_channels for all at once.

features.title: An RGB light with transitions
features.text: Colours are mixed from the real LED spectra of the model. Brightness keeps the mix, transition fades in gentle steps.

features.title: Holds what you set
features.text: Late echoes, the lamp's own scene after power-on or a power cut: Home Assistant restores what it last set, at most once a minute.

features.title: Honest states
features.text: Values always come from the lamp. Without contact entities are unavailable, never a guessed 0 %. Commands count only once confirmed.

features.title: Robust Bluetooth
features.text: One queue for all commands, firm time limits, clean reconnects, backoff when the lamp is silent. Works through ESPHome proxies, with a preferred proxy.

features.title: Programs in the lamp
features.text: Read the automatic and professional program, write a professional day schedule and up to seven timed effects. They run without Home Assistant.

features.title: Effects and weather
features.text: The lamp's effects on the light card. With a weather entity, a thunderstorm outside plays lightning in the tank for a few minutes.

features.title: Diagnostics that help
features.text: Reachable with proxy, signal and last error, a repair issue after 30 minutes of silence and a diagnostics download without MAC address.

entities.title: Light
entities.text: light.<name>_light: RGB from the five channels, brightness, effects, transition. Attribute channels with the real values.

entities.title: Channel numbers
entities.text: Reef: pink, cyan, blue, purple, cold_white. Plant: pink, blue, cold_white, pure_white, warm_white. 0 to 100 % each.

entities.title: Mode and weather
entities.text: mode (manual, automatic, professional), weather_effects and weather_effect_minutes.

entities.title: Buttons and switch
entities.text: identify, sync_clock and reconnect. hold_state switches restoring the desired state on and off.

entities.title: Sensors
entities.text: last_seen, source and signal_strength of the connection, timed_effects stored in the lamp.

entities.title: Diagnostics
entities.text: reachable with the attributes gatt_connected, source, rssi and last_error.

items.title: FFF0 service
items.text: Commands on FFF2, replies as notifications on FFF1, also through ESPHome Bluetooth proxies.

items.title: D1 + CBOR
items.text: Mode, power, channels and effects as separate frames, like the app, then a state read as confirmation.

items.title: D2 state
items.text: The full state, split over several packets and put back together, every 30 seconds and on every change.
